name: fable-routed

workers.name: sonnet-worker
workers.takes: repo scans and file inventories, edits limited to an explicit file list, running tests, extraction and summaries, checking processes or jobs and reporting progress and status

workers.name: opus-worker
workers.takes: code review, non-trivial refactors, and coding that needs design judgment

notes: Default. Sonnet 5 does mechanical bounded work; Opus 5 does work that needs judgment; unnamed spawns default to sonnet.
